description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder' constructs and manages configuration schema interchanges for HTMLPurifier, including building from directories, parsing configuration hashes, and handling directives and namespaces.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_InterchangeBuilder
classes.description: Class responsible for constructing configuration interchange objects for HTMLPurifier, including parsing directories and configuration hashes, and creating directives and namespaces.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the variable parser, defaulting to HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Native if none provided.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Builds an interchange object by reading configuration files from a specified directory.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds an interchange object based on a configuration hash, determining if it is a namespace or directive.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Creates and adds a namespace to the interchange based on hash data.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Creates and adds a directive to the interchange based on hash data, parsing various directive attributes.

methods.name: evalArray
methods.description: Evaluates a string as PHP array code without the array() wrapper.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Converts an array list into a lookup array with values as keys.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Creates an ID object from a string ID.

methods.name: _findUnused
methods.description: Checks for unused keys in the hash and triggers a notice if any are found.
